title: LIGA: turning organic chemistry into a browser puzzle with AI assistance
author: Typical-Instance-376
selftext:
I'm Samuel, a physics teacher and the creator of Quanta Aulas. I developed LIGA with help from Sol 6.0: a browser game where players investigate a dossier and connect organic molecules with their structures.



The design question I'm working on is how to make chemistry recognition feel like solving a case rather than clicking through a quiz. AI assistance can help build an interface, but a working interface alone doesn't tell me whether the learning mechanic is clear.



Playable build: [https://quantaaulas.com/liga/](https://quantaaulas.com/liga/)



I'd appreciate feedback from fellow developers: does the first case communicate what you're meant to do, and would you improve the onboarding, visual feedback, or structure-reading challenge first? This is my own game, shared as self-promotion for feedback.
